relationships.subject: NGF
relationships.evidence_quote: NGF also drives increased expression of TRPV1 in sensory neurons through the recruitment of transcription factor Sp4

relationships.subject: Sp4
relationships.evidence_quote: supporting the idea that factor Sp4 positively regulates TRPV1 expression

relationships.subject: Sp4
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that a 50% reduction in Sp4+/- mice decreased TRPA1 mRNA expression in DRG

relationships.subject: NGF
relationships.evidence_quote: NGF induces an increase in the mRNA and protein encoding preprotachykinin, the precursor of substance P, and calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP)

relationships.subject: Mithramycin A
relationships.evidence_quote: mithramycin dose-dependently decreased TRPV1 mRNA, TRPV1-immunoreactive protein expression and the number of capsaicin-responding DRG neurons in primary culture

key_findings: NGF drives TRPV1 and TRPA1 overexpression in nociceptors via the Sp1-like factor Sp4, sustaining persistent hypersensitivity.
Sp4 haploinsufficiency reverses NGF- and oxaliplatin-induced hypersensitivity; mithramycin reduces TRPV1 expression.
